source_notes: On 28-29 May 2026 Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) signed a 25-year terminal operator agreement with Ukwanda LNG to develop the Ngqura LNG import (regasification) terminal. Ukwanda LNG is a JV between Tamasa Energy Group and the Strategic Fuel Fund. GEM currently lists the operator as 'Strategic Fuel Fund Association' alone; the named TOA counterparty is now Ukwanda LNG. ~R22bn ($1.34bn) project incl. a TNPA-built dedicated LNG berth; full operations targeted for 2035.
